t: From the Rule of 7 to a Self-Healing Knowledge Tree
s: This article explores organizing information for AI and humans using the 'Rule of 7' (5-9 choices) to prevent cognitive overload. It details a transition from basic associative arrays to a robust 3-column system using vector embeddings/perceptual hashes for self-healing and dynamic knowledge trees.
sub: Rule of 7 for cognitive load management
